solver_note: The pressure Poisson problem is singular when every side is Neumann and the right-hand side (velocity divergence minus the combustion expansion the projection is supposed to leave) does not sum to zero. The open top is now a Dirichlet boundary, ghost pressure 0, so that expansion can leave. Divergence is still div(u) - expansion, the residual of the equation being solved, on every projection, with no incoming-RMS cutoff. p99_median is the median of the 99th-percentile reduction of |div| over the whole volume; most cells are empty, so that percentile sits near the plume edge and moves less than the RMS.
